overview: Case-control study nested in the ICU clinical information system, March 2025 to June 2027, with a primary association, one secondary resource outcome, a balancing measure and a process measure; the day-3 marker is proposed as an accuracy outcome.
population: Adults ventilated for more than 48 hours with an MRC sum score at ICU discharge. Cases: score below 48. Controls: score 48 or more, two per case, matched on ventilation duration band and admission quarter.
exposure: Number of missed mobilisation days among the first five days on which the patient met the bundle's readiness criteria.
procedures: The research nurse extracts daily readiness, mobilisation status, ICU Mobility Scale, severity score, deep sedation days, sepsis and corticosteroid use, blind to case status where the extract allows.

outcomes.name: Association of missed mobilisation with ICU-acquired weakness
outcomes.measure: Adjusted odds ratio for weakness (MRC sum score below 48 at discharge) per missed eligible day
outcomes.timing: First five eligible days; weakness at ICU discharge

outcomes.name: Excess ICU days in cases
outcomes.measure: Difference in ICU length of stay between cases and matched controls, valued at the ICU day rate
outcomes.why: The director's resource question, reported descriptively.

outcomes.name: Day-3 ICU Mobility Scale as an early marker
outcomes.measure: Area under the receiver operating characteristic curve for weakness

outcomes.name: Adverse events during mobilisation
outcomes.measure: Line or tube dislodgement, falls and desaturation during sessions

outcomes.name: Documentation completeness
outcomes.measure: Eligible days with a recorded mobilisation status
outcomes.why: Missing documentation could be mistaken for missed mobilisation.

feasibility: About 150 cases and 300 controls by June 2027; extraction of five eligible days per patient fits two research nurse days per week.
biasMitigation: Exposure counted on eligible days only
Adjustment for severity and deep sedation
Extraction blind to case status where possible

biasFlags.label: Confounding by severity
biasFlags.note: Central threat; eligibility restriction and adjustment.

biasFlags.label: Documentation as exposure
biasFlags.note: Undocumented days are reported separately, not assumed missed.

flags: Two secondary questions from the director
parsimony.simplestPath: One exposure, one case definition, one adjusted odds ratio.

theoreticalFramework: None beyond the causal diagram of severity, sedation, mobilisation and weakness.
summary: Nested case-control protocol with the director's questions as secondary outcomes.
